Tip: You can create a desktop shortcut for CODM using the following path: [copy]\n"C:\\Program Files\\Tencent\\GameLoop\\Application\\GameLoopLauncher.exe" --launch-proc-name GameLoopEmulator.exe --launch-pkg-name com.activision.callofduty.shooter --from 8

Tip2: You can remove Google Play appearing at game start: - Create a desktop shortcut for Settings using the following path: [copy]\n"C:\\Program Files\\Tencent\\GameLoop\\Application\\GameLoopLauncher.exe" --launch-proc-name GameLoopEmulator.exe --launch-pkg-name com.android.settings --from 8 - Go to: Apps → See all aps → Google Play services → first force stop then disable it
